strengths: When the plan broke, you looked for the next step instead of stopping.
You looked past the first problem to what the people involved really needed.
You turned the discussion into steps: who does what, and by when.
growth: When you suggest a change, say what could go wrong and how you would keep it small.
Explain your decisions openly, especially to the people they affect.
nextTime: Next time you propose something, add one sentence on the risk and how to limit it.
Next time, tell the people affected what you decided and why, in your own words.
